_comment: MINDLOCK setup: FTMO, FundedNext, FundingPips, Foxx Funded on MT5, Topstep on TopstepX, Lucid on Tradovate. Copy to trader/journal/connectors.json (the Windows installer does it). MT5 needs no password: keep each firm's MT5 open, the journal reads the account logged in there. Several accounts at one firm: each one syncs whenever it is the account open in MT5, and its trades stay in the journal. Never commit this file.

connectors._option: Lucid without Tradovate API access: export the Performance report (CSV) into this folder
connectors.name: Lucid exports

connectors._option: accounts on cTrader or Match-Trader: export the history (CSV) into this folder
connectors.name: cTrader / Match-Trader exports

connectors._option: an MT5 account the terminal is not logged in: lets the journal switch to it (investor password)
connectors.name: FTMO 2

_secrets: Paste your keys between the quotes. This file stays on your PC (trader/ is never sent to GitHub). Or write "env:NAME" to read a Windows environment variable.
